title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer must correctly express E in terms of m_t as E = 5/4 m_t c^2.

title: Energy-Momentum Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The response should demonstrate the application of energy-momentum conservation principles in the analysis.

title: Rest Frame Analysis
description: Important Criteria: The response must include a consideration of the top quark's rest frame and how it relates to the lab frame.

title: Gamma Factor Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of the gamma factor for the W boson must be shown and correctly derived.

title: Kinematic Possibility
description: Optional Criteria: The response should discuss the kinematic possibility of the W boson being produced at rest.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for common sign errors in the momentum conservation equations.

title: Mass Neglect Justification
description: Optional Criteria: The response should justify the neglect of other particle masses in the calculations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that units are consistent throughout the calculations, especially when relating energy and mass.
